Definition: comparative from G2736; inferior (locally, of Hades):--lower.
BiblicalUsage: Katoteros means lower, the parts beneath. Ephesians 4:9 says Christ descended first into the lower parts of the earth before he ascended.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Christ went down before he went up, so there is no depth he has not already been.
